stories.title: Zheng Yongnian on China-US realism and battling for the upper hand before the next summit

en.title: Zheng Yongnian on China-US realism and battling for the upper hand before the next summit
en.summary: A Chinese political scientist and government adviser discusses perspectives on the Xi-Trump summit in Washington, addressing assessments that the meeting lacked significant breakthroughs.

stories.title: US Air Force removes all bombers from UK airbase targeted by suspected terror attack

en.title: US Air Force removes all bombers from UK airbase targeted by suspected terror attack
en.summary: The US Air Force has withdrawn all bomber aircraft from RAF Fairford in England following an investigation into a planned terror attack at the military facility.

stories.title: Serb separatist Dodik declares victory in Bosnia vote as ethnic tensions, EU hopes collide

en.title: Serb separatist Dodik declares victory in Bosnia vote as ethnic tensions, EU hopes collide
en.summary: A Bosnian Serb nationalist politician claimed victory in elections held amid economic challenges, EU integration prospects, and ongoing ethnic tensions rooted in the country's 1992-95 conflict.

stories.title: Netanyahu orders security review of international flights to Israel after Flydubai attack

en.title: Netanyahu orders security review of international flights to Israel after Flydubai attack
en.summary: Israel's prime minister has ordered a comprehensive security review of international flights to the country following an attempted aircraft hijacking by an Omani co-pilot on a Dubai-bound flight.

stories.title: Iran tells US there is no military solution to Middle East war

en.title: Iran tells US there is no military solution to Middle East war
en.summary: Iran's top diplomat stated that military action cannot resolve the conflict with the United States, as recent heavy bombardment has failed to achieve decisive results. Washington has recently shifted toward economic pressure rather than continued military operations.

stories.title: Hundreds of schools to close on Monday as education protests rock France

en.title: Hundreds of schools to close on Monday as education protests rock France
en.summary: Up to 500 French schools will be closed or partially closed on Monday due to student-led protests that have disrupted the country. The closures are described as security precautions following incidents of vandalism and arson at educational facilities.

stories.title: Dozens detained at a rally in Moscow held by Kremlin-friendly Communist Party, party says

en.title: Dozens detained at a rally in Moscow held by Kremlin-friendly Communist Party, party says
en.summary: Moscow police detained approximately 60 people at a Communist Party rally on Sunday, mostly young attendees, according to the party's statement. The gathering commemorated the Kremlin's 1993 suppression of a parliamentary uprising.

stories.title: Brazilians head to polls in high-stakes, polarised election

en.title: Brazilians head to polls in high-stakes, polarised election
en.summary: Brazilians voted on Sunday in a closely contested election featuring 13 candidates, with leftist President Lula and Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, son of former president Jair Bolsonaro, as the leading contenders. The campaign centered on corruption, economic concerns, and allegations of external interference.

stories.title: Ukraine believes Russia shared jet-drone technology with North Korea, says Zelensky

en.title: Ukraine believes Russia shared jet-drone technology with North Korea, says Zelensky
en.summary: Ukrainian President Zelensky stated he believes Russia may have shared jet-drone technology with North Korea. Russia has intensified its use of jet-drones against Ukraine in recent weeks, while North Korea has previously supplied Russia with artillery shells and ballistic missiles.

stories.title: UK Green Party adopts ‘Zionism is racism’ policy, drawing backlash from Israel

en.title: UK Green Party adopts 'Zionism is racism' policy, drawing backlash from Israel
en.summary: Britain's Green Party voted to define Zionism as racism at its annual conference, with 1,022 members voting in favor and 813 against. The decision has drawn criticism from British Jewish groups and the Israeli government.

stories.title: Hong Kong builders take three WorldSkills honours in best CIC haul

en.title: Hong Kong builders take three WorldSkills honours in best CIC haul
en.summary: Hong Kong construction workers won three Medallions for Excellence at WorldSkills Shanghai, marking the strongest performance by the Construction Industry Council at the competition. Winners included Law Chak-sum in painting and decorating, Tse Yu-lok in welding, and a concrete construction team.

stories.title: Police surround Wong Tai Sin flat after woman reportedly seen with knife in area

en.title: Police surround Wong Tai Sin flat after woman reportedly seen with knife in area
en.summary: Hong Kong police responded to a report of a woman in her forties carrying a knife near Diamond Hill MTR station and searched the area. Officers then attempted to enter a flat at a Wong Tai Sin estate where the woman was traced.

en.title: 140 Years of Everyday Moments
en.summary: DFI Retail Group, founded in Hong Kong in 1886, has grown into a business serving everyday consumer needs including food, beverages, groceries, and home furnishings over 140 years of operation.

stories.title: LIM Advisors founder George Long: ‘We’ve been here 30 years. We’re going to be around’

en.title: LIM Advisors founder George Long: 'We've been here 30 years. We're going to be around'
en.summary: George Long, founder and chief investment officer of LIM Advisors, expresses confidence in the independent Hong Kong-based firm's longevity after three decades of operation. Long is characterized as a pragmatic leader focused on capital preservation in Asian markets.

stories.title: More Hong Kong homes sell at a loss despite signs prices have bottomed: agents

en.title: More Hong Kong homes sell at a loss despite signs prices have bottomed: agents
en.summary: Hong Kong saw at least 100 secondary residential properties sell at a loss in September, up from 81 in August, even as market indicators suggest property prices may have stabilized and begun recovering. Agents project year-end prices could be approximately 15 percent higher than the prior year despite the continued losses on individual transactions.

stories.title: How Malaysia offers Chinese investors Singapore’s comfort at prices lower than Thailand

en.title: How Malaysia offers Chinese investors Singapore's comfort at prices lower than Thailand
en.summary: Malaysia is attracting Chinese property investors as a middle ground, offering Singapore-like stability at prices comparable to Thailand. According to property data, Malaysia ranked fourth among destinations for Chinese buyer inquiries in the first half of 2026.

stories.title: Quality over quantity: China’s AI microdrama producers battle viewer fatigue

en.title: Quality over quantity: China's AI microdrama producers battle viewer fatigue
en.summary: Chinese AI microdrama producers are focusing on quality content as viewer interest plateaus. NetEase used AI technology to reconstruct scenes featuring actress Joey Wong, demonstrating how the industry is experimenting with artificial intelligence in entertainment production.
